title: Height and setback regulations
previewText: For buildings subject to the height and setback regulations of Section 23-421 (Basic pitched-roof envelopes for certain districts), the following modification shall apply: each perimeter wall of the building or other structure may have one or more apex points directly above it on the 35 foot high plane.
